title: Pentel Writing Essentials 10 Pack

comparisons.notes: Same Writing Essentials 10 pack (SKU BLQELZBP10M, UPC 072512290477), 7.20 (reg 2.00), variant available

writeup: Woot has the Pentel Writing Essentials 10 pack for $11.99. The set includes 4 EnerGel Pearl 0.7mm gel pens, 2 Twist Erase III 0.7mm mechanical pencils, 2 Hi-Polymer block erasers and 2 packs of Hi-Polymer 0.7mm HB lead. Pentel's own store lists the same set at $27.20, so this is about 55% less. Woot showed only 1 left.
